submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied old W walking frame into exactly ONE independently painted RUN frame W01 of16, preserving the girl's exact face, costume, short proportions and white-fox companion. Image 1 is identity/camera/appearance reference and prior walk pose to improve. Image 2 is approved STYLE only: clean bright rounded Chinese Daoist chibi hand painting with detailed soft fur and cloth, not its UI.
Keep silver short bob, furry ears, purple eye, snowflake ornament on anatomical LEFT temple, white/lilac fur-trimmed short robe, purple sash and silver fox buckle, blue charms, bare knees and boots. Strict single-eye LEFT side profile, camera sees her anatomical LEFT side. NEAR anatomical LEFT arm must securely cradle one white fox; FAR RIGHT open palm carries one blue snowflake crystal. Both shoulders and elbows must actually move in the run while holding these same objects; no swap of hands, no fox floating off arm.
01 LEFT-foot contact: NEAR anatomical LEFT leg reaches forward toward screen LEFT, heel touches ground y942; knee slightly flexed. FAR RIGHT leg is behind toward screen RIGHT, heel high, toes just pushing away. RIGHT crystal-carrying shoulder and elbow swing FORWARD opposite the right leg, palm ahead of chest. Torso inclines 10 degrees toward screen LEFT. This is energetic running contact, with a long readable split between legs.
Fixed orthographic RPG camera, same head size as reference. Normalized1024 canvas has fixed virtual ground y942, character root x563, standing ear-tip y80; retain natural rising/lowering and airborne foot clearance. Do not auto-center silhouette, scale each bounding box, glue lowest foot to ground or lift the whole unchanged drawing. Output one genuinely new run pose, native square at least1024x1024 transparent RGBA, complete body with safe margins. No girl's tail, extra limb, staff, effects, trail, particles, floor, shadow, background, grid, text or labels. Clean natural alpha edges; no chroma-key blue/magenta fringe.
